children: By Tom Sims and Valentina Za

CEO Andrea Orcel wants Bettina Orlopp to leave her job as the CEO of Commerzbank and is opposed to the German government's demand to maintain two supervisory board seats, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, as the Italian lender moves closer to taking over its German rival.
UniCredit also wants Commerzbank Chairman Jens Weidmann to leave, two of the people said.
UniCredit didn't immediately respond to a request for comment and Commerzbank declined to comment.
The German finance ministry declined to comment further after it said on Monday it wants to keep two board seats.
